author: More Perfect Union
description:
Trump nominated Todd Blanche to be the new US Attorney General.

There's just a few problems. Blanche interviewed Ghislaine Maxwell and gave her a platform to lie before she got a prison transfer. He's also friends with her lawyer.

Blanche is also mixed up with the DOJ failing to release all of the Epstein files.

And he's invested in crypto, tied to a firm that broke the law and was investigated by the FBI, and much, much more.
title: He buried the Epstein files. Now he could be America’s next Attorney General.
